lines: I can't even
I HATE MEMES THAT SAY "UPVOTE IF YOU AGREE"
UPVOTE IF YOU AGREE
CAN'T CONNECT TO INTERNET WINDOWS: "CHECK FOR SOLUTIONS ONLINE."
WHEN YOU MAKE AN INTELLIGENT MEME WITH A DEEP MEANING
NO UPVOTES, ONE COMMENT POINTING OUT YOUR ONE MISSPELLED WORD BY THE NEWEST IMGFLIP USER
365 DAYS UNTIL CHRISTMAS
AND PEOPLE ALREADY HAVE THEIR LIGHTS UP
WHEN THE AD IS LONGER THAN THE VIDEO
WHEN SOMEONE COMPLAINS HOW POOR THEY ARE ON THEIR NEW IPHONE
NOTHING SCREWS UP YOUR FRIDAY
LIKE REALIZING IT'S ONLY TUESDAY
WHEN A MEME THAT ASKS FOR UPVOTES GETS ON THE FRONT PAGE
THE FLAT EARTH SOCIETY
..HAS MEMBERS ALL AROUND THE GLOBE
A GUY IN MY CLASS SAID.... I DONT HAVE TO LEARN MATH BECAUSE IM GOING TO BE AN ARCHITECT
WHEN YOUR MOM SEES AN OLD FRIEND AT THE GROCERY STORE
TO CELEBRATE MY 1 YEAR ANNIVERSARY ON IMGFLIP
I MADE A MEME THAT GOT ZERO UPVOTES, TO PROVE I STILL CAN DO IT A YEAR LATER
WITH SO MANY THINGS COMING BACK IN STYLE
I CAN'T WAIT UNTIL MORALS AND RESPECT BECOME A TREND AGAIN
I HEARD THAT IN SOME COUNTRIES, SUICIDE WAS A CRIME THAT WAS PUNISHABLE BY DEATH
THIS THANKSGIVING, MY THOUGHTS AND PRAYERS GO OUT TO EVERYONE
WHO HAS TO DO THE DISHES
WHEN SOMEONE REPOSTS YOUR MEME AND YOU GET ACCUSED OF REPOSTING THEIRS
WHEN THE TEACHER PICKS THE SLOWEST READER
MY WIFE WANTED A CAT
I DIDN'T WANT A CAT, SO WE COMPROMISED AND GOT A CAT
DEMOCRAT TIM KAINE BLAMES ‘GUN VIOLENCE’ FOR OHIO STATE CAR-AND-KNIFE ATTACK
CAR. AND. KNIFE.

meaning.meaning_en: This meme expresses deep frustration, exhaustion, or secondhand embarrassment in response to a specific situation or statement. The text boxes are used to set up the context or the annoying event in the first box, and the punchline or the speaker's reaction (like 'I can't even') in the second box.
meaning.meaning_de: Dieses Meme drückt tiefe Frustration, Erschöpfung oder peinliches Mitgefühl auf eine bestimmte Situation oder Aussage aus. Die Textfelder werden verwendet, um im ersten Feld den Kontext oder das nervige Ereignis zu beschreiben und im zweiten Feld die Pointe oder die Reaktion des Sprechers (z. B. 'Ich schlag die Hände hoch') zu liefern.
situations_en: My boss just assigned me a task due tomorrow
I forgot to save my document for 3 hours of work
He literally said 'it's not a bug, it's a feature'
I just realized I left the stove on
My friend is explaining a joke for the 5th time
situations_de: Mein Chef hat mir gerade eine Aufgabe für morgen zugewiesen
Ich habe mein Dokument nach 3 Stunden Arbeit vergessen zu speichern
Er hat buchstäblich gesagt: 'Das ist kein Bug, das ist ein Feature'
Ich habe gerade gemerkt, dass ich den Herd an hatte
Mein Freund erklärt mir den Witz zum 5. Mal
